title: Hand 3: transfer of the fixed position and boundary spelling mixture
statement: Apply the fixed M-005 mixture to hand 3: glyph-trigram spelling, position-conditioned and preceding-edge-conditioned spelling, position vocabulary, page-local exact or one-glyph copying, and a prefix-core-suffix template. Compare predictive cost with bag and glyph spelling baselines; the mixture tests predictive fit and does not identify the historical production process. Layout positions and previous word are supplied, including across line breaks within a page. On 1,953 public practice words, the fixed M-005 mixture scores 10.9636 bits per word, versus 11.2817 for the M-001 configuration refitted on the same hand and identical pages. This is an exploratory comparison.
source: M-005 fixed configuration, also applied to hand 1; trusted component definitions in vs/models.py.
